title: Daily Amount Withdrawn by the Family-Adjustment Relief
content:
**TRICARE Premium-Based Plans - TRICARE Reserve Select ledger rule.**

The daily amount the family-adjustment relief withdraws follows what was paid on the adjustment: where no payment stands against it, it is the amount of the adjustment divided by the days it covers; where a payment covers only part of it, it is the part still unpaid divided by those days; otherwise nothing is withdrawn, the paid adjustment is returned with the early-duty month credit instead.

The amount of the adjustment is the total of the coverage-type adjustment bills for the most recently paid month, and the days it covers are the total of the days those bills cover; the payment is what is posted against the adjustment bill.

## Cases (hypothetical: adjustment of 88.24 covering 11 days)

| Paid on the adjustment | Daily amount withdrawn |
|---|---|
| nothing | 88.24 divided by 11, 8.0218 |
| 40.00 | the unpaid 48.24 divided by 11, 4.3855 |
| 88.24 | nothing |
